If you want to learn how to dance, just GO to any dance lesson. Seriously, just go. There are several dance schools in any decently large city (Latin, waltz, whatever), and most should have calendars posted. Some schools will have a package of a few lessons (like $20 or $30) so the can teach a class consistently, and some have a "just show up and pay $10 and you're in" policy. Some cities even have free lessons open to the public, sometimes these are big casual events.

You do not need a partner to go to these. Everyone rotates partners anyway, and usually there are more women than men.

Seriously, just look up a place, and go. Give them a phone call ahead of time to make sure the lesson is for beginners (though you'll be fine for most intermediate lessons too) and to make sure you can find the place, and just go.
